# Data Preparation

## Loading library

```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

## Loading the dataset

```{r}
mydat <- st_read("final_df.geojson")
dim(mydat)
```

## Removing census tracts with invalid spatial coordinates

```{r}
table(st_is_valid(mydat))
analysis.dat <- mydat[st_is_valid(mydat),]
```

# Viewing the dataset

```{r}
View(analysis.dat)
```

# Collecting the column names

```{r}
ournames <- names(analysis.dat)[c(1:35,37,63:76,77:202,206,207, 226:228, 347:358, 376:379, 384:387, 392:395)]

newdata <- analysis.dat %>%
  select(all_of(ournames))

dim(newdata)
```

# See the var types

```{r}
glimpse(newdata)
```

# Replace "NULL" with NA in every character column

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.character),
    ~ na_if(., "NULL")
  ))
```

# Keep columns that has NA less than 50% 

```{r}
na_col <- colMeans(is.na(newdata)) * 100
cols_to_drop <- names(na_col[na_col > 50])

newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(-all_of(cols_to_drop))
```

# Changing the Median Family Income to numerical

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = MedianFamilyIncome,
      .fns  = ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))    
    )
  )
```

# Extracting the first 2 characters of the string, and changing the data from character to numeric of the column starts with "P_"

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("T_"),        
      ~ as.double(str_sub(.x, 1, 2))
    )
  )
```

# Averaging the columns of D_, P_, ... etc

# Getting the column names

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    non_Pollution = rowMeans(across(all_of(non_cols))),
    d_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(d_cols))),
    p_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(p_cols))),
    b_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(b_cols))),
    t_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(t_cols)))
  )

newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(
    -all_of(non_cols),
    -all_of(d_cols),
    -all_of(p_cols),
    -all_of(b_cols),
    -all_of(t_cols)
  )         
         
glimpse(newdata)
```
